title: Coral and the Safehouse
author: Marguerite Montrose
blurb: Cyrus Halloran, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, works cases no one wants attributed. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the summit convenes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
